snippet.title: Plant Plots // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857190/Plant_Plots/

Plant Plots is a relaxing puzzle board game where you'll need to be a clever gardener to make it through a variety of tricky levels. But watch out, these plants don't behave quite like the ones you're used to. Dive in and unwind as you solve beautifully crafted puzzles.

Developed by 
Padoru Games
